basis: S04 owner-reviewed G01-G03 research decisions, plus the owner-supplied consolidated S02-D01..D06 / S03-D01..D09 approval register forming G01 closure basis.
provenanceWarning: Original S02/S03 proposal snapshots remain intact. Their 15 subsequent research approvals, forming the S04-G01 closure basis, are now independently recorded in s02-s03-owner-approvals.json; full deliberations and individual amendment diffs were not supplied.

gates.provenanceNote: Owner has supplied 6 S02 and 9 S03 approved research/governance positions as the 15 antecedents to G01 research closure. Full G01 deliberations and amendment diffs are not provided; G01 finding IDs have not been invented.

ownerApprovedAntecedentDecisions.ownerApprovedResearchPosition: Reject technology, payload and delivery-format shortcuts for intrinsic Product-family classification
Separate meaning-bearing semantic constitution from runtime analytical machinery
Adopt governed informational value as the leading primary VBE hypothesis
Ground family adjudication in Product Promise and PIN; preserve credible competing interpretations
Preserve conditional Product-family invariance across eligible PFI realizations
Permit conditional research drafting without prematurely adopting normative qualification
Preserve the KivaNura analogy as informative, not normative
Inherit independent BPS Productness as Q0
Research informational VBE and coherent, bounded proposition families as Q1
Research meaning-bearing semantic constitution as Q2
Research essential informational value capability as Q3
Apply BPS/PIN identity invariants to informational continuity as Q4
Treat competing-family adjudication as Q5, a procedural gate rather than an intrinsic property
Distinguish realization invariance, semantic fidelity and contractual conformance

decisions.title: Independent generic BPS Productness
decisions.finding: Q0 inherited from BPS/PIN and is a prerequisite to a definitive Information Product determination; INFOPS cannot confer Productness.

decisions.title: Primary informational VBE
decisions.finding: Candidate Information-specific specialization of PIN; necessity and sufficiency unproven.

decisions.title: Meaning-bearing semantic constitution
decisions.finding: Candidate GEARM-grounded specialization; does not require an owned runtime engine or independently established Interpretive Frame object.

decisions.title: Essential consumable informational capability
decisions.finding: Candidate EVC specialization; no universal API, analytics engine, or active execution requirement.

decisions.title: Coherent PIN and Product identity/version invariants
decisions.finding: Candidate identity and Version coherence requirement; independent necessity unproven.

decisions.title: Competing-family and Compound adjudication
decisions.finding: Procedural/evidence review gate, NOT an additional ontological attribute.

decisions.title: Cross-condition reconciliation
decisions.finding: Logical independence and universal necessity of Q1-Q4 and joint sufficiency of Q0-Q4 remain unproven; no qualified/certified Products.

decisions.title: Upstream Source Inventory and Authority Classification
decisions.finding: Adopt Information-native INFOPROD semantic descriptor and INFOPDS deployment/realization specification as research design direction, analogous to the separation of AIPROD/AIPDS without importing AIPS AI semantics. External Data DPROD and DPDS are not INFOPS foundations.

decisions.title: BPS/PIN source, Productness authority and adoption eligibility
decisions.finding: BPS generic Productness, Product Promise, PIN, Family, Kind and Product identity remain upstream. PIN conceptual source identified, immutable governing Version not pinned; no normative adoption.

decisions.title: GEARM semantic source, version and authority
decisions.finding: GEARM 0.1 RC1 identified research candidate; generic Information/Information Proposition and analytical semantic authority preserved. INFOPROD references and specializes without redefining.

decisions.title: GEARA architecture source, version and authority
decisions.finding: GEARA 0.1 RC1 research candidate; governed direct analytical consumption differs from optional Productization. Applicable architecture, not qualification. Owner clarification: BPS DPP applies to all Product families.

decisions.title: GEDRM/GEDRA Data semantics and architecture authority
decisions.finding: GEDRM 0.1 Data semantics, GEDRA 0.1 Data architecture; competing-family review without automatically classifying enriched Data as Information. GEDRA A14 closure blocker and GEDRM Source of Authority formal-kind gap retained.

decisions.title: AIPS/GEAIRM AI Product and enterprise AI semantics
decisions.finding: AIPS AI Product qualification and GEAIRM enterprise AI semantic authority retained; AI dependency does not transfer AI Family; Information output does not transfer Information Family. AIPS Stage 14 and GEAIRM A15 source status limits retained.

decisions.title: GEAIRA enterprise AI architectural authority
decisions.finding: GEAIRA 0.1 human-readable M17 frozen Working Draft; applicable AI architecture does not establish Information Family, mandatory AI implementation, or consequential action authorization.

decisions.title: UPOS/HDIP-CLA realization authority
decisions.finding: UPOS conceptual Product-kind agnostic architecture; HDIP-CLA 0.1 M17 frozen, A15 bounded formalization closed. INFOPROD semantic, INFOPDS realization, HPD operational projection, BPS DPP trust remain distinct.

decisions.title: BPS DPP Core and Information-specific DPP Profile
decisions.finding: BPS DPP Core cross-family; candidate 0.1 Core URI and release unverified, namespace divergence unresolved. Future Information DPP Profile extends BPS for trust/evidence; DPP cannot confer Productness.

decisions.title: Upstream source compatibility and adoption readiness
decisions.finding: Accept conceptual authority coherence and conditional G03 research closure; source pins, compatibility and normative adoption remain NOT READY. G04-G07 obligations retained; no normative specification or Product certification.

historicalStageSeparation: Original S02 and S03 research ledgers retain their as-authored PROPOSED status. Subsequently approved owner-reviewed decisions are explicitly registered in S04-G01 owner approval addenda; research approvals do not confer normative adoption.
